ops.en: a speech or piece of writing that highly praises someone, especially at or after their death
ops.cn: 颂词；高度赞扬某人的演讲或文章，尤常见于葬礼或逝世之后

ops.en: avoiding direct answers, commitment, disclosure, or a clear position
ops.cn: 含糊其辞的；回避直接回答、承诺或表态的

ops.en: intended to avoid capture, danger, difficulty, or contact
ops.cn: 用于躲避抓捕、危险、困难或接触的

ops.en: happening, existing, or becoming true at the end of a process or after a period of delay
ops.cn: 最终的；经过一段过程或延迟后发生/形成的

ops.en: to legally force a tenant or occupant to leave a property, or more generally to expel someone from a place
ops.cn: 依法驱逐租户或占用者；更广义指把某人赶出某地

ops.en: to praise, glorify, or honor someone or something very highly
ops.cn: 高度赞扬；颂扬；推崇

ops.note: Also raise someone in rank, character, or status.

ops.en: of very high rank, status, position, or importance
ops.cn: 地位崇高的；级别很高的

ops.note: Also elevated in moral, intellectual, or stylistic character.

ops.en: to irritate, annoy, or frustrate someone intensely
ops.cn: 使极度恼怒、烦躁或沮丧

ops.note: Older aggravate/make-worse sense is lower priority.

ops.en: to dig out or remove earth to create a hole, trench, site, or other hollow space
ops.cn: 挖掘；挖土形成坑、沟或施工场地

ops.en: to uncover or recover buried remains, objects, or structures by digging
ops.cn: 通过挖掘发掘被埋藏的遗物、物体或结构

ops.en: the act or process of keeping someone or something out, or the resulting state of being excluded
ops.cn: 排除；排斥；把某人/某物排除在外的过程或状态

ops.en: thorough and complete, covering all or nearly all relevant possibilities, details, or items
ops.cn: 详尽无遗的；全面彻底的

ops.en: to make someone feel very happy, excited, refreshed, or full of energy
ops.cn: 使兴奋愉快；使精神振奋、充满活力

ops.en: broad, wide-ranging, extensive, or ambitious in area, scope, or scale
ops.cn: 广阔的；范围广泛的；规模宏大的

ops.en: open, friendly, confident, and talkative in manner
ops.cn: 开朗健谈的；态度开放友好的

ops.note: Psychiatric specialist usage is lower priority.

ops.en: convenient and practical for achieving an immediate purpose, sometimes at the expense of principle or long-term considerations
ops.cn: 权宜的；为达到眼前目的而方便实用的，有时会牺牲原则或长期利益

ops.en: a means or measure used to achieve a particular end
ops.cn: 权宜之计；为达到某一目的采取的手段

ops.en: to explain, present, or develop an idea, theory, or argument in detail
ops.cn: 详细阐述、解释某个观点、理论或论证

ops.en: formal: to make wrongdoing, a fault, or an offense seem less serious or more forgivable
ops.cn: （正式）减轻过错或罪责的严重性；使显得情有可原

ops.meaning_cn: 减轻责任、可予谅解的情节

ops.en: to destroy or kill completely a population, group, or infestation, especially pests
ops.cn: 灭绝；彻底消灭某一群体或害虫种群
ops.usage_note: A strong and violent verb; use carefully when referring to people.

ops.en: to obtain money, information, compliance, or another benefit by force, threats, intimidation, or abuse of authority
ops.cn: 敲诈、勒索；通过武力、威胁、恐吓或滥用权力获取钱财、信息或服从

ops.meaning_cn: 从某人处强行勒索/逼取某物

ops.en: to free or remove someone or something from a constraint, entanglement, or difficult situation
ops.cn: 解脱；使摆脱束缚、纠缠或困境

ops.en: full of lively energy, excitement, enthusiasm, or abundant vigorous growth
ops.cn: 充满活力、兴奋或热情的；也可指生长旺盛的

ops.en: growing or produced in great abundance; luxuriant
ops.cn: 生长繁茂的；大量旺盛的

ops.en: full of lively energy, excitement, or enthusiasm
ops.cn: 充满活力、兴奋和热情的

ops.en: famous, legendary, or renowned, whether or not literally described in a fable or legend
ops.cn: 著名的；传奇般的；久负盛名的

ops.en: joking or trying to be humorous about something that should be treated seriously, often inappropriately
ops.cn: 轻佻打趣的；对本应严肃的事开玩笑的

ops.en: artificially created, contrived, or deliberately produced rather than naturally arising
ops.cn: 人为制造的；非自然形成的；刻意炮制的

ops.meaning_cn: 做作性障碍；人为制造或诱发症状的精神医学诊断术语

ops.en: capable of making mistakes, being wrong, or failing
ops.cn: 可能犯错的；并非绝对可靠或不会失败的

ops.en: of speech, a voice, or performance: to lose strength, confidence, fluency, or steadiness
ops.cn: （说话、声音或表现）变得无力、犹豫、不流畅或失去稳定

ops.note: Also hesitate, become uncertain, or weaken.
Can describe hesitant or unsteady movement.

ops.en: a person with excessive or extreme enthusiasm or devotion to a cause, belief, activity, or interest, usually disapproving
ops.cn: 狂热者；对某事业、信念或兴趣过度狂热投入的人，通常带贬义

ops.en: showing excessive or extreme enthusiasm or devotion
ops.cn: 狂热的；过度热衷的

ops.en: an absurd, ridiculous, badly managed, or sham situation or process
ops.cn: 闹剧；荒谬可笑、敷衍造假或管理混乱的局面

ops.note: Theatrical farce is a comedy based on broad humor and improbable situations.

ops.en: foolish, silly, or pointless, often in a complacent or self-satisfied way
ops.cn: 愚蠢的；无意义的；常带自鸣得意却缺乏判断的意味

ops.en: fiercely violent, savage, aggressive, or extremely intense
ops.cn: 凶猛的；猛烈的；激烈到极端的

ops.en: showing intense, sincere passion, enthusiasm, belief, or feeling
ops.cn: 热烈真挚的；充满强烈热情、信念或感情的

ops.value: Literal fervent = extremely hot is archaic and not learner-main.

ops.en: intense passion, enthusiasm, or strong feeling
ops.cn: 热情；激情；强烈的感情

boundaries.note: British spelling of the same noun.
